scan_metadata.notes: Fresh shallow clone of default branch (depth 20), so has_uncommitted_changes reflects the clone (false) not the author's working copy. The repo is an Agent Skill (Markdown docs plus build helper scripts and templates), not a running service. One Python script (build_plugin.py) was read; shell scripts (build_plugin.sh, deploy_local.sh, tests/smoke_build.sh), Makefile and GitHub Actions YAML are out of scope for full interface/data-access detection in skill version 1.0 and were only inspected for secrets, network calls and env use. The only external host string found, example.invalid, is a deliberate test fixture in tests/smoke_build.sh. No dependency manifest for Python/Node; setup.cfg and ruff.toml are lint configs.

findings: build_plugin.py imports only the standard library; no manifest is needed. Workflow templates run linters and scanners via 'uv run --with' at CI time (detect-secrets and others), declared inline rather than in a manifest.

proper_secret_handling_found.mechanism: GitHub Actions built-in github.token via GH_TOKEN env (no stored secret)
GitHub Actions github.token; template also runs a detect-secrets gate that fails on findings

file_system_access.detail: copies plugin sources into a temp staging dir, deletes stale staging dirs, writes a plugin zip
installs the built plugin into a local QGIS profile plugins directory

what_this_app_can_do: Provides guidance and reference documents that teach an AI coding agent how to write, debug, package and publish QGIS plugins.
Builds a plugin zip from a manifest and verifies it, and can copy it into a local QGIS profile.
Release workflow validates version consistency and creates a GitHub Release using the workflow token.

data_sources_touched.source: Local plugin source tree and local QGIS profile directory

capability_summary.who_can_reach_it: No network service. Scripts run locally by whoever invokes them; the release workflow runs in GitHub Actions with contents: write permission.

top_findings: No secrets, routes or databases found; this is a documentation and build-tooling skill
Release workflow grants contents: write (needed to create releases); .gitignore does not list .env or key files
